PAID TIME OFF
Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid time off (PTO) per calendar year. Part-time employees receive PTO proportionally to their scheduled hours. New hires accrue PTO monthly from their first day. Requests for more than five consecutive days should be submitted at least two weeks in advance.

REMOTE WORK
Employees may work remotely up to three days each week with their manager's agreement. Client records must stay on approved company devices. Do not send client files to personal email addresses or public file-sharing services.

EXPENSES AND SUPPORT
Approved business expenses should be submitted within 30 days with a receipt. Reimbursements over $250 require manager approval. Urgent support requests concern access outages; standard support requests are reviewed within one business day.

benchmark.label: Measured scheduler microbenchmark · synthetic timed jobs · no inference or GPU claims
benchmark.method: Same five jobs and same service durations. All are admitted at t=0; invoice-1 starts before policy selection. asyncio.sleep represents timed synthetic work. Actual wall-clock waits measured with perf_counter. Running work is not interrupted. OS scheduling adds timing jitter; this demonstrates queue policy only.

recommendation.answer: Measured scheduler microbenchmark using synthetic timed jobs (invoice-1, invoice-2, support-urgent-1, invoice-3, support-urgent-2) with service durations from 30-120 ms. All jobs admitted at t=0; actual wall-clock waits measured via perf_counter. FIFO policy shows mean wait of 184.57 ms (urgent: 275.88 ms). Priority policy reduces urgent wait to 136.74 ms (50.43% improvement), total duration 373.28 ms. No inference/GPU claims; asyncio.sleep simulates timed work. Human approval required for priority mode if urgent response time outweighs FIFO order.
